description: This file contains unit tests for the SystemHandler class within the ai.openclaw.app.node package. It specifically tests the handling of system notifications, including permission checks, request validation, and posting notifications through a poster interface. The tests utilize mock implementations to simulate different scenarios.

classes.name: SystemHandlerTest
classes.description: Test class for SystemHandler; contains multiple test functions to validate notification handling behavior.

classes.name: FakePoster
classes.description: Mock implementation of SystemNotificationPoster, used in tests to simulate posting notifications.

classes.name: ThrowingPoster
classes.description: Mock implementation that throws exceptions when post is called to test error handling.

methods.name: handleSystemNotify_rejectsUnauthorized
methods.description: Tests that unauthorized handling of system notifications is rejected appropriately.

methods.description: Tests rejection when notification content is empty or whitespace.

methods.name: handleSystemNotify_rejectsInvalidRequestObject
methods.description: Tests rejection for incomplete or invalid notification JSON objects.

methods.name: handleSystemNotify_postsNotification
methods.description: Ensures valid notifications are successfully posted.

methods.description: Tests that optional fields are properly trimmed and passed.
